subject: the doc-maintenance review on a claim the implementation contradicts
subject_kind: a shipped document claim, and the source that decides it
source: commit 0e7cf8ca, which corrected docs/development/host_requirements.md from Homebrew hints to per-host install hints, against scripts/install.sh
configuration_variable: the doc-maintenance skill, absent in none, present as landed in skill, and inverted to compare claims against other documents in inverted

cases.prompt: I think some of the shipped docs have drifted from what the code does. Check the documents under docs/ against the implementation and write what you find to report.jsonl in the repository root.
cases.expected_output: A JSONL report that names docs/development/host_requirements.md and ## Enforcement, names scripts/install.sh and what it prints, and reports the Homebrew-hints claim as contradicted.
cases.fixture: the repository at HEAD, trimmed to one commit, with the ## Enforcement sentence reverted to the pre-correction wording. scripts/install.sh carries the deciding source.
assertions: The report names the document and the section
The report names the deciding source and what it shows
The report does not report the claim as correct, and does not report an unsupported contradiction
cases.measurement: the JSONL report at the project root, graded blind against R1, R2 and R3

notes: The fixture, the three package roots and the evidence live under $HOME/workspace/output/evals/doc-maintenance-review/, which persists between sessions and is never committed. The fixture bundle is a single commit, so the correction is not in the history the run can read.
